---
title: "Day"
subtitle: "Four parts, with a facilitator"
---

In this format you work for one day as analyst no. 6 on the Europeanisation and the economy case study. Its original author (OA) asked whether the economic crisis changed how citizens of the member states frame the European Union, and five analysts reanalysed one claim of the paper for the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026).

## How you work

The tasks of the day are done in the workspace that you install before the day, in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), while the deck of the day shows each step with its output. If your installation fails, the deck, whose cells run R inside your browser, and the browser lab, a page of the course site that holds the same tasks, carry the work and give the same numbers.

[Install R and the workspace](before.qmd#the-workspace){.btn .btn-primary} [Open the deck](../../live/day.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The day runs in four parts, with a break after the first and the third and lunch after the second.
